summary: Wrote a nine-phase plan separating the two deliverables the research report showed are independent: landing the Tier-2 sliced witness (which no longer waits on anything) and removing the three recomputation faults in the shipped liveness decision procedure. A plan-time compiled check found the report's recommendation 1 is not executable as written -- C36b's c36Sliced reads the slice labelling, and certA labels only 'atom p', so the row would have failed the gate -- and established the minimal repair: carrying snceP on the labelled slice makes c36Sliced [c36Snce] true while certA.Certifies still proves by kernel decide in 87 s under a finite maxHeartbeats. The three performance fixes are ordered by increasing blast radius, each behind an unconditional equality lemma, with the leaf cache gated on a measurement because the report's gains are #eval figures and the gated proofs run decide.

artifacts.summary: Nine phases, 14 h, waves [[1],[2,3],[4],[5],[6],[7],[8],[9]]; 31 pinned Lean Challenge identifiers; two declared contingency branches (leaf-cache gate, certB bounded decide).
